changes: Compared with cabinet-v2026.10.06.1: stationary subscription grid with real right-to-left node-radius pulses, a 12-second cycle, no pulse in the left 35% and reduced-motion support across trial/active/expired/limited states.
Trial and tariff icons/colors are aligned with the accepted interface without changing subscription actions.
Classic purchase retains the confirmed summary during delayed, out-of-order and failed price requests; recalculation text is hidden and payment remains guarded until the current response.
Closing a ready top-up payment returns to the correct Cabinet subscription and preserves the renewal selection using the existing API.
User-group cards in purchase and gift flows open loyalty status information and return to the original route.

limitations.summary: Existing unchanged Upstream Bot behavior requires manual confirmation after top-up; frontend does not close this limitation.
Existing unused createEmail wrapper declares an endpoint absent from the exact Bot schema; the current form uses the supported createCombined -> /send. The wrapper is unchanged.
Full response-field parity and authenticated staging remain unverified. Local unit and mocked browser checks do not establish full runtime compatibility.
Physical Telegram Android/iOS, accessibility, payment/recovery/renewal/concurrency/panel/admin scenarios were not verified by local checks.
The unchanged dependency lockfile has 11 npm audit findings (1 low, 2 moderate, 8 high). Audit remains non-blocking under the existing release policy; no fix or reachability conclusion is claimed.
